definitions.explanation: An emperor who has abdicated the throne. The formal title for a Japanese emperor after retirement, reinstated in 2019 when Emperor Akihito abdicated.

examples.japanese: {上皇|じょうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{退位|たいい}→退位：19973_taii⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Emperor Emeritus abdicated the throne.

examples.japanese: {上皇|じょうこう}⟦{陛下|へいか}→陛下：14566_heika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧⟦{御所|ごしょ}→御所：12847_gosho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{住|す}まい→住まい：11555_sumai⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: His Majesty the Emperor Emeritus currently resides in the Imperial Palace.

examples.japanese: ２０１９⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{退位|たいい}→退位：19973_taii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧２００⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{上皇|じょうこう}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{称号|しょうごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{復活|ふっかつ}→復活：12565_fukkatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the 2019 abdication, the title of Emperor Emeritus was revived for the first time in about 200 years.

notes:
The official title given to a Japanese emperor after abdication. Used with the honorific suffix ⟦{陛下|へいか}→陛下：14566_heika⟧ (His/Her Majesty) when referring to the current holder.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上皇|じょうこう}⟦{陛下|へいか}→陛下：14566_heika⟧: His Majesty the Emperor Emeritus
- {上皇|じょうこう}{后|ごう}: Empress Emerita (wife of Emperor Emeritus)
- {上皇|じょうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become Emperor Emeritus

ETYMOLOGY:
The title was last used in 1817. It was revived in 2019 when Emperor Akihito abdicated in favor of his son. Distinguished from related historical titles like {太上天皇|だいじょうてんのう} (the older formal form).

HOMOPHONES (different kanji):
- ⟦{乗降|じょうこう}→乗降：20526_joukou⟧: getting on and off (a vehicle)
- ⟦{条項|じょうこう}→条項：18974_joukou⟧: clause, article (of a contract)
